name: quorum: The Orchestra's Consensus Layer: Lenses in, a Typed Verdict Out
description: The consensus layer of the Crop Analytics Orchestra. Registers any member's estimate of a shared estimand as a lens with declared independence, expressiveness and scope; compares a quorum of lenses with the hub's agreement semantics; resolves the comparison through a declared policy into a typed verdict and an orchestra manifest. A quorum of independent lenses must agree before an answer is carried, and no quorum means abstain. Carries the on-ramps by which non-hub estimates become lenses: ensemble-source ingestion, surrogate emulators of expensive fits, ensemble-derived priors, posterior predictive checks for surrogates, and the koine fourth-opinion backend. Depends on 'flexyBayes' for the core model representation and emits results in the same shapes.
